cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Raise the Stakes
cards.instruction: Persuade them to accept a larger risk, cost, or commitment so the outcome will feel decisive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I slid my queen off the board like you did. Let's make this game decide who cooks all weekend.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I took my captured queen off. You just removed your best piece.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally, playing with fewer pieces. All the more reason to put something serious on the result.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're already at a disadvantage. Let's just play for the biscuit.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then let me put the queen back. Will you play for Sunday dinner instead of a biscuit?

reason: Replace the final significance summary with a concrete proposed restoration and a direct question accepting a larger-than-biscuit stake. Preserve B's fairness concern as the cause.
